progressionBeats: Earn first coins from Coin Loop.
Buy Coin Upgrade near the one-minute mark.
Unlock Auto Collector and open Bonus Alcove.
Reach Quick Rebirth by the target session end.

sessionPacing.earlyGame: Spawn in Starter Pad, learn income, and buy the first upgrade within 45–90 seconds.
sessionPacing.midGame: Route through Upgrade Kiosk to add automation and unlock the gated area.
sessionPacing.lateGame: Use Bonus Alcove for prestige/rebirth setup and creator handoff checks.
